A1.justification: Both readable, complete 19-page PDFs describe ARPG. The main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–E can be matched reliably; v3 adds Appendices F–G.

before.justification: v2 reports original ARPG image-generation results, efficiency measurements, controllable generation, and ablations in Section 4 and Appendix B, alongside generated examples.

after.justification: v3 retains original ARPG benchmark results, efficiency measurements, ablations, and qualitative generation results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The two-pass architecture, randomized training, positional queries, shared KV projection, and parallel decoding procedure are retained. Appendix E only shortens comments and inlines the existing loss-target expression.

E1.justification: Both versions use ImageNet-1K, the 4M BLIP-3o subset, GenEval, Canny/depth conditioning, and the same zero-shot image-manipulation tasks. Appendix F proposes future extensions without evaluating additional datasets or tasks.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments. Table 2 changes NAR's attribution from Wang et al. to He et al., without replacing the evaluated method. Table 3 retains LlamaGen-XL, Chameleon, and SD-v1.5.

E3.justification: The reported training budgets, model configurations, metrics, efficiency-profiling procedure, and ablation protocols are retained. Table 3 newly specifies 512×512 resolution, but v2 states no conflicting resolution; this is additional documentation, not an established protocol change.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 and Appendix B retain the architecture, decoding-step, attention-pattern, generation-order, scalability, and attention-map analyses. Figure 3's revised description of multiple distinct heads accompanies unchanged attention maps.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: Table 3 swaps the reported throughputs: LlamaGen-XL changes from 4.32 to 0.83 img/s, and SD-v1.5 from 0.83 to 4.32 img/s, reversing their speed ranking. ARPG remains at 30.11 img/s. Quality scores and the other benchmark and appendix results are unchanged; the PDFs do not establish reruns.

T1.justification: Equations 1–11 and Appendix C's gradient derivation retain the same mathematical content and qualifications. Equation punctuation, spacing, and alignment changes do not revise the reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction now distinguish approximately 30× speedup over raster-order models from 3× over recent parallel AR models, refining v2's less specific efficiency summary. The method contributions, zero-shot claims, FID of 1.83, and 75% memory-reduction claim remain.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning attention generalization, scalability, and zero-shot behavior are retained. Appendix F lists prospective extensions but adds no substantive explanation of results, failure condition, or limitation of the reported work.

D1.justification: Table 3 newly documents that its text-to-image comparison uses 512×512 resolution. Architecture and hyperparameter details in Appendix A, hardware information, sampling instructions, and the code-access link remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Appendix F adds literature connections for future unified multimodal models, AR–diffusion combinations, caching, quantization, and pruning, including Show-o/Show-o2, Dimple, and D-AR. This is a limited extension of research positioning; the existing related-work argument and novelty claims are retained.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized abstract, introduction, caption, and Appendix B edits; adds acknowledgments and short discussion and LLM-use appendices; and replaces the preprint header with an ICLR 2026 publication header. The central narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: All figures and tables are retained. Figure 3 and Table 3 have revised captions, with minor typesetting and reference reflow elsewhere. Appendix E's pseudocode now fits on page 18 instead of continuing onto page 19.

improvement.justification: v3 improves reporting clarity by distinguishing efficiency comparison classes, specifying Table 3's resolution, and correcting NAR's attribution consistently with the existing references. The throughput swap revises baseline reporting but does not establish improved model performance. These are limited gains in clarity and traceability; the method and experimental and theoretical support remain essentially unchanged.
